_comment: Harvestcore GAME rules (ADR 0009 Phase 3b). Player picks up produce → relates to inventory; depositing at chest emits a signal that converts produce→gold and removes the produce entity.

rules._comment: Player walks within 48px of sell_chest → emits deposit_trigger signal. Signal-triggered deposit rules then loop over all held produce items (via in_inventory tag) regardless of their stored position. This avoids the contact-proximity issue with produce items (which stay at their spawn position, not following the player).
On deposit_trigger signal, each in_inventory produce item adds its sell_value to farm_ledger_1 gold. self=each produce item. Literal target 'farm_ledger_1' resolves to the singleton economy entity.
Removes produce after gold is collected. after deposit_collect_gold ensures gold is added before entity is removed.
Player contacts loose produce → relate held_by + tag in_inventory. tags_none: in_inventory prevents re-pickup of already-held items.
